newsitem.title: UK: EMS/Mark softer but off lows after German M3, repo.
newsitem.headline: EMS/Mark softer but off lows after German M3, repo.

text.p: The mark eased on its crosses as German M3 money supply growth slowed in July and the Bundesbank set its repo tender at an unchanged fixed rate of 3.00 percent -- further dampening speculation of an imminent rate rise.
"The M3 numbers are quite weak and give less reason to expect a Bundesbank (rate) move," said Adrian Schmidt, international economist at Chase Investment Bank.

Speculation of higher rates mounted after hawkish comments from Bundesbank officials last week and fears that the recent strength in dollar/mark -- which scaled a near eight-year high over 1.89 marks in early August -- could fuel inflation.
